cases.source:
• Cora: reserve the rehearsal room by Tuesday.
• Keep the east door locked until the caretaker arrives.
• The rehearsal may run late; no extra session is confirmed.
usefulEditCriteria: Format: retain three already-good bullets. Unchanged output is acceptable in this control; equivalent bullet markers, light punctuation changes, and concise faithful paraphrases are also acceptable.
Cora reserves the rehearsal room by Tuesday. Cora and that deadline do not implicitly apply to the other two notes.
The east door stays locked until the caretaker arrives. Do not change east to another entrance, omit locked, or imply it must be unlocked before arrival.
The rehearsal may run late, and an extra session is not confirmed. Preserve both uncertainty and the lack of confirmation without creating a scheduled extra session.
Do not add a title that changes scope, introduce an explanatory preface, duplicate any note, or rewrite clear bullets into less readable prose.

cases.source:
- Ravi haalt donderdag het rekwisiet op.
- Gebruik de hoge kruk alleen tijdens de fotosessie.
- We weten nog niet of er een reservekruk nodig is.
usefulEditCriteria: Format: retain three already-good Dutch bullets. Unchanged output is acceptable in this control; exact wording and bullet marker style are not required.
Ravi collects the prop on Thursday. Do not make Thursday a confirmed photoshoot date or assign all notes to Ravi.
The tall stool is for use only during the photoshoot. Preserve both the tall-stool distinction and the restriction, without attaching that photoshoot scope to every note.
The need for a spare stool is unknown. Do not convert it into a decision to obtain one or a statement that none is needed.
Preserve the concise existing structure without inventing a heading, owners, deadlines, extra tasks, or explanatory commentary.

cases.source:
• Vera: collect the ceramic samples by Thursday.
• Ivo: photograph the cracked frame on Friday.
• The replacement glass may arrive late; do not promise a delivery date.
usefulEditCriteria: Already-good control: retain each named assignment, its separate deadline and uncertainty/prohibition. Unchanged output is acceptable.

cases.source:
- Sana: controleer de reserveband voor dinsdag.
- Pieter: haal donderdag het statief op.
- We weten nog niet of de lens gerepareerd kan worden.
usefulEditCriteria: Already-good control: preserve source owners and separate times entirely in Dutch. Keep the repair unresolved.

cases.source:
- Um, Keiko should check the window latch before Monday.
- Uh, keep the storage door locked until the caretaker comes back.
usefulEditCriteria: Remove the two empty opening pauses. Preserve Keiko as checking owner and the locking prerequisite. Raw passthrough fails.

cases.source:
- Malik sends 6 sample packets. No, make that 9 sample packets.
- Do not send the spare labels yet.
usefulEditCriteria: Resolve six to nine; Malik remains sender. Keep the temporary prohibition as a separate note. Do not retain both counts as current tasks.

cases.source:
- Theo will calibrate the sensor. Actually, Bea will calibrate it.
- Theo should record the meter reading tomorrow.
usefulEditCriteria: Bea calibrates; the prior Theo assignment is superseded. Theo records the meter tomorrow; do not move that deadline to calibration. A faithful resolved edit is required.

cases.source:
- Zora checks the windows Emre locks the side entrance.
- We have not selected a closing time.
usefulEditCriteria: Split Zora checking and Emre locking into separate complete owner-action bullets. Keep the undecided time separate. Two unchanged bullets fail.

cases.source:
- For the radio room: Petra orders the shielded cable.
- For the archive: Milo labels the boxes before Wednesday.
usefulEditCriteria: Already-good control: retain both local context labels and their correct owner/action. Do not treat context labels as people.

cases.source: for the rehearsal Noura checks the stage lights Tomas brings the spare microphone we have not decided when to open the doors
usefulEditCriteria: Unformatted transformation: preserve rehearsal scope, both separate owners and undecided opening time. Passthrough is not a success.
